title: Prime Minister's Office (National Climate Change Secretariat)
what_it_is: Prime Minister's Office (National Climate Change Secretariat)

sections.label: Climate resilience and emissions commitment
sections.summary: Singapore will strengthen climate resilience and manage emissions for sustainable growth, and is on track to cut emissions 16% below business as usual by 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: We will strengthen our resilience against the risks from climate change and manage our greenhouse gas emissions to achieve economic growth in a sustainable manner.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: We are already on track to fulfil our existing commitment to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 16% below business as usual by 2020.

sections.label: Singapore's 2030 emissions commitment
sections.summary: Singapore committed to reduce Emissions Intensity by 36% from 2005 levels by 2030 and stabilise greenhouse gas emissions with the aim of peaking around 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: In line with the Agreement, Singapore has made a further commitment to reduce our Emissions Intensity1 by 36% from 2005 levels by 2030 and stabilise greenhouse gas emissions with the aim of peaking around 2030.

sections.label: Industry and household energy efficiency measures
sections.summary: Industries must improve energy efficiency and cut emissions, supported by the Energy Conservation Act, programmes, incentives, solar scale-up, and household appliance labelling and standards.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: Our industries will have to step up efforts to re-examine their processes and implement measures to enhance energy efficiency and reduce emissions.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: This will be complemented by mandatory measures under the Energy Conservation Act, as well as various capability building programmes, incentives and financing schemes.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: For example, solar deployment will be scaled up from the current 47 MWp, to provide around 350 MWp of electricity by 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: Household energy efficiency will continue to be improved through the Mandatory Energy Labelling Scheme, which provides information to help consumers make more informed decisions when purchasing household appliances.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: The Minimum Energy Performance Standards scheme will ensure that only household electrical appliances2 that meet minimum energy performance standards can be sold in Singapore.

sections.label: Second National Climate Change Study projections
sections.summary: The first phase of the Second National Climate Change Study, completed in April 2015, provides long-term climate projections to assess impacts and plan resilience measures.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: The first phase of the Second National Climate Change Study completed in April 2015 provides the long-term climate projections for Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: We will build on these projections to assess the impact on Singapore and develop plans to enhance our resilience in areas, such as coastal protection, water resources and urban infrastructure.
